resources.string: Start with your Google account. Next, choose your name and save a passkey to keep your memories private.
Already here? Sign in with a passkey
Choose your existing Remanence passkey to open your account and restore access to your memories.
This is how people find you on Remanence. Your name becomes permanent when setup is complete.
Save a passkey in your password manager. When its dialog closes, come back here to verify the key.
You will need a passkey provider that supports encrypted account recovery. Saving the key is the first step; verification checks that it can protect your memories.
One more step: select the same key to check access and finish setting up your account.
Saved in your passkey provider. Verification is still needed before your memories are ready.
Cancelled or cannot find the key? You can try verification again here. This does not create another passkey.
The passkey provider may have saved your key, but confirmation did not finish. Check setup before continuing; do not create another key.
Once you send a postcard, its delivery and opening details will appear here.
Choose what you share to improve Remanence
